title: Pest Control Customer Completion Sign-Off Form
subtitle: Control inspection, monitoring, exclusion, treatment, and follow-up through verified identity, domain-specific observations, evidence, authorization, exception ownership, and accountable closeout.
description: An original, workflow-complete pest control customer completion sign-off for treatment zones, devices, products, and pest observations. It connects approved pest plan, product label, and site authorization to present conditions, repeatable evidence, decisions, unresolved work, and the receiving party's handoff.
use_case: Use when a qualified pest-management technician and customer or authorized site representative must reconcile the promised pest control scope, actual work, evidence, limitations, remaining actions, and custody transfer.

sections.guidance: Tie customer review to the exact job and receiving representative, not to an ambiguous signature line.

sections.title: Pest Control limitations, unresolved concerns, and callback plan
sections.guidance: Acceptance must not conceal a defect, incomplete task, service restriction, or promised follow-up.

blocks.label: Unresolved condition or follow-up trigger
items: Target pest cannot be reliably identified
Product label, SDS, registration, or intended-use direction unavailable
Applicator credential or supervision requirement not satisfied
Child, pet, food, feed, medical, or other sensitive exposure unresolved
Wind, rain, temperature, runoff, pollinator, or water condition outside limits
PPE, first-aid, spill-response, or decontamination resources unavailable
Product spill, leak, damaged container, misapplication, or unintended exposure
Treatment area cannot be secured, ventilated, posted, or kept vacant as required
Observed organism, damage, or site condition requires another qualified discipline
Customer requests a rate, site, method, or reentry instruction outside labeling

sections.title: Pest Control customer completion sign-off closeout and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when outcome, remaining limitation, next action, evidence, and receiving ownership agree.

blocks.label: Remaining action and follow-up register
Final outcome, handoff, and record location
Record boundary and stop condition
blocks.guidance: This pest control customer completion sign-off is an operational record, not a substitute for applicable law, licensing, product labeling, manufacturer instructions, site policy, safety requirements, or professional judgment. Stop affected work, access, application, operation, testing, or release when target identification, product labeling, applicator qualification, occupant protection, weather, exposure, spill, or treatment boundary is uncertain. A pest-management compliance supervisor must review the exception, authorize the controlling decision, and preserve its evidence before closeout.

blocks.label: Prepared, reviewed, and accepted
blocks.guidance: A signature records accountability for the stated outcome; it does not cure missing evidence or override a stop condition.
